perturbations.name: leave_one_group_out
perturbations.description: drop one group and refit on the rest
perturbations.reason: k=2 groups; dropping one leaves a single group

perturbations.name: block_jackknife
perturbations.description: drop 1/10 of the analysis units and refit
perturbations.reason: only 12 units; block deletion leaves too few per block

perturbations.name: exclude_extremes
perturbations.description: exclude values outside the 1.5*IQR fence of their own group (pre-specified, disclosed)
perturbations.reason: no value fell outside its group's fence

perturbations.name: strict_complete_case
perturbations.description: restrict to rows complete across every numeric outcome (listwise), versus the primary's per-outcome complete cases

perturbations.name: imputation_sensitivity
perturbations.description: complete-case refit on the columns the cleaning plan imputed
perturbations.reason: nothing was imputed; every analysed value was observed

perturbations.name: row_level_comparison
perturbations.description: the row-level secondary analysis from inferential.json, kept for comparison; it treats repeated rows as independent and its n is inflated

perturbations.name: rank_cross_check
perturbations.description: the rank-based cross-check recorded on the primary test in inferential.json (assumption robustness)
